paragraph: Jayden Daniels zips a 32-yard touchdown pass to Stefon Diggs with 57 seconds left! Washington takes the lead in New York. Earlier, Cam Skattebo ran for a touchdown to put the Giants ahead. Daniels then found Antonio Williams for a score. J.J. McCarthy hit Isaiah Likely for a 66-yard touchdown, and the Giants led again. But Daniels had one last clutch throw, and Washington won 24-21! It was Washington’s first road win of the season.

big_words.definition: Coming through when it matters most.
big_words.example: Leo made a clutch grab when his dog’s leash slipped.

paragraph: Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 2 touchdowns as the Lions beat the Patriots 35-10 in Munich. What a dominant day for Detroit! Jared Goff zipped a 56-yard touchdown pass to Amon-Ra St. Brown. Goff found St. Brown for another touchdown in his German homecoming. Gibbs ran for 153 yards and caught passes for 99 more. The win lifted the Lions to 7-2, while the Patriots fell to 5-5.

big_words.definition: Much stronger or better than the other side.
big_words.example: Priya was dominant at recess, kicking 3 goals in the soccer game.

paragraph: 101 rushing yards made Emmett Johnson's first start a big one! He also caught 2 touchdown passes from Patrick Mahomes. Josh Downs scored in his Chiefs debut. Mahomes threw 5 touchdown passes as Kansas City beat Atlanta 35-13! Bijan Robinson ran for a Falcons touchdown. The win moved the Chiefs into a first-place tie in the AFC West at 7-2.

big_words.definition: A person's first time doing something.
big_words.example: Marcus made his garden debut by planting bright yellow flowers.

paragraph: In Cleveland, the Browns hoped to end a 2-game losing streak. Houston jumped ahead 17-0 on a touchdown pass to Xavier Hutchinson. Deshaun Watson ran for a score, and KC Concepcion tied it at 17-17. Then C.J. Stroud found Dalton Schultz to put Houston back on top. The Browns had one more comeback in them! Quinshon Judkins ran 5 yards for the winning touchdown with 53 seconds left. Cleveland won 27-24 and moved to 6-4.

big_words.definition: A string of things that happen one after another.
big_words.example: Sofia kept her streak of talent show practice going for 3 days.
Sofia made a comeback after forgetting a line at the talent show.

paragraph: Could Kirk Cousins spark the Vikings in his return? He sure did! Cousins tossed 2 touchdown passes as Minnesota beat Green Bay 30-10 in Wisconsin. Myles Price snagged the first, and Aaron Jones ran for another score. Jordan Love threw a touchdown pass to J. Michael Sturdivant for the Packers. Then Cousins found Gavin Bartholomew for his second touchdown! The Vikings snapped a 2-game skid and moved to 7-2.

big_words.example: Jamal’s cookie idea helped spark a fun day of baking.

paragraph: The scoreboard in Tennessee read Jaguars 40, Titans 23! Trevor Lawrence zipped a 2-yard touchdown pass to Parker Washington. Lawrence later found Brenton Strange to put Jacksonville ahead 23-13. Cam Ward hit Tony Pollard for a 32-yard touchdown, cutting the lead to 30-23. But Bhayshul Tuten's 6-yard touchdown run helped stop the rally! The Jaguars moved to 7-2 and led the AFC South by 4 games.

big_words.definition: A push to catch up after falling behind.
big_words.example: Hana made a rally at her swimming lesson and reached the pool wall.

paragraph: Miami came close, but the Colts won 24-22 in Indianapolis. Seth McGowan ran 4 yards for a Colts touchdown. Miami struck back when Malik Washington hit Jalen Tolbert for a 34-yard touchdown. Adetomiwa Adebawore recovered a fumble in the end zone for a Colts touchdown. Then Miami grabbed momentum as Chris Johnson returned an interception 59 yards for a touchdown! Kyle McCord ran for a score, but the 2-point try failed. The Colts ended a 5-game skid and improved to 3-7, while Miami fell to 1-8.

big_words.definition: A burst of energy that helps you keep going.
big_words.example: Diego gained momentum as he raced to finish his library book.

paragraph: Ryan Fitzgerald kicked a 54-yard field goal as time ran out! The Panthers beat the Saints 20-17 in New Orleans. Earlier, Alvin Kamara caught a touchdown to put the Saints ahead. Chuba Hubbard ran for a score to put Carolina back on top. Charlie Smyth tied it with a 55-yard kick, setting up Fitzgerald's big moment. The victory ended Carolina's 3-game slide and kept the Panthers in first place in the NFC South.

big_words.example: Ava cheered after her bike ride victory over the steep hill.

paragraph: James Cook races 74 yards for a Bills touchdown! Josh Allen also ran for 2 scores. His second put Buffalo ahead 17-9. Then Allen zipped a 45-yard touchdown pass to DJ Moore. The Bills beat the Jets 31-12 and climbed to 8-1. Allen also broke the record for touchdowns by a player in his first 10 seasons.

big_words.definition: The best mark anyone has reached.
big_words.example: On a rainy day, Kofi set a record for stacking blocks.

paragraph: Drew Lock tossed 2 touchdown passes as the Seahawks beat the Raiders 21-13! In Las Vegas, Fernando Mendoza ran 10 yards for a Raiders touchdown. Lock then zipped a 34-yard touchdown pass to Cooper Kupp. Jadarian Price ran for a touchdown in the third quarter. Lock struck again with a spectacular 71-yard touchdown pass to Jaxon Smith-Njigba! The defending Super Bowl champs moved to 6-4, while the Raiders fell to 4-6.

big_words.example: Lily made a spectacular pink sign for her lemonade stand.

paragraph: 31 straight points sent the Rams racing past the Cardinals in Arizona! The Rams won 34-6. Matthew Stafford tossed 3 touchdown passes, including one to Xavier Smith. Blake Corum ran for 100 yards and a touchdown. The Rams were unstoppable as they won their fourth straight game! They moved to 6-4, while Arizona fell to 3-7.

big_words.example: Mateo felt unstoppable as he built his science project.

paragraph: In Dallas, the 49ers and Cowboys chased a big win. Brock Purdy zipped a 74-yard touchdown pass to Christian McCaffrey! Then Deebo Samuel raced 70 yards for another 49ers touchdown. The 49ers led 38-19 in the fourth quarter, but Dallas was determined. The Cowboys scored 3 touchdowns, with Dak Prescott finding CeeDee Lamb for the last one! San Francisco held on to win 46-40. The 49ers climbed to 8-1, while Dallas fell to 4-6.

big_words.example: Zoe was determined to build her block tower as tall as her chair.

paragraph: Who ruled the field in Cincinnati? The Bengals did, beating the Steelers 38-18! Joe Burrow tossed 4 touchdown passes, and Ja'Marr Chase snagged 231 yards. Chase Brown caught a touchdown pass, too. Aaron Rodgers fired touchdown passes to DK Metcalf and Pat Freiermuth in the fourth quarter. But the Bengals soared to their 5th straight win! They moved to 7-2 and took first place alone in the AFC North.

big_words.definition: Moved or rose high and fast.
big_words.example: Ethan's kite soared above the trees on his camping trip.

paragraph: The final score in Baltimore read 23-20, Chargers! Justin Herbert ran 22 yards for a touchdown. Omarion Hampton ran in for another score. Cameron Dicker’s field goal put Los Angeles up 23-13. Derrick Henry’s touchdown run pulled the Ravens within 3 points. Then the Chargers recovered a crucial fumble by Zay Flowers. Los Angeles earned its first win of the season, ending an 11-game losing run.

big_words.example: Nia made a crucial catch when the birthday balloon slipped away.
